title: Browser support matrix
description: docs/adr/0028: one entry per observed piece of technical evidence (a polyfill, a vendor-prefixed CSS rule, user-agent-sniffing code). browserslist_query is the Browserslist query-string value this evidence implies, null when the evidence alone doesn't determine one. business_reason is unset by default, filled in by a human reviewer (prd's hitl_status pattern, ADR-0009) - never inferred from the site. performance_baseline_refs cites performance-baseline.json's own template_hash by reference (point 3), never duplicating its threshold data. Entirely absent in v1 - no polyfill/vendor-prefix/UA-sniffing detection instrumentation exists; this schema validates the shape build_browser_support_matrix produces against synthetic fixtures only.
